title: ArsN No More Warp Scroll
description: This Datapack makes the Ars Nouveau Warp Scrolls unobtainable.
body:
# Remove Warp Scrolls from your world!

This datapack completely eliminates Warp Scrolls from Ars Nouveau, giving both players and modpack creators control over how teleportation is handled. Warp Scrolls are powerful items that allow instant travel, but with this datapack, they are no longer obtainable by any means.

- **Crafting removed:** The Warp Scroll crafting recipe is deleted, so players cannot craft them.

- **Shady Wizards eliminated:** All Shady Wizard villagers, who sell Warp Scrolls, are automatically _**KILLED**_.

**Why use this datapack?**

Players who feel Warp Scrolls are too overpowered can remove them for a more balanced experience.

Modpack creators can also use it to encourage alternative travel methods, whether through other mods or custom teleportation mechanics.

____

**Installation:**
1. Download the datapack.

1. Place it in your world’s datapacks folder.
  
1. Load the world — no commands or configuration required.

## WARNING
THIS **_KILLS_** ALL VILLAGERS WITH THE "SHADY WIZARD" PROFESION, ONLY ADD TO A WORLD IF YOU DON'T MIND THIS FACT.
